title: Pen Nib
description: Every [blue]10th[/blue] Attack you play deals double damage.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Tracks the number of Attacks played. Every 10th Attack in a sequence deals double damage. The relic displays a counter (0-9) showing progress toward the next double-damage trigger, and shows as Active when ready to trigger.
